UPDATE forge_io_task SET status=#{status},row_count=#{rows},error_code=#{code},failure_reason=#{reason},result_object_id=#{result}, finished_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='AWAITING_CONFIRM' THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT id,type,source_object_id,created_by,row_count,query_summary FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND status IN ('WAITING','RUNNING') AND heartbeat_at < #{cutoff} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_io_task SET status='FAILED',error_code='io.interrupted',failure_reason='执行中断，请重新提交',finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND status IN ('WAITING','RUNNING') AND heartbeat_at < #{cutoff}

UPDATE forge_io_task SET status='FAILED',error_code='io.confirmationExpired',failure_reason='超过24小时未确认，请重新提交', finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND type='IMPORT' AND status='AWAITING_CONFIRM' AND heartbeat_at <= #{cutoff}
